text: Mag Tuired was an Irish mythological site. It was also written Moyturra, Mag Tuirid, Magh Tuireadh, or Moytirra. Two great battles of Irish myth took place on the plain. In both, the Tuatha Dé Danann won control of Ireland from another race. In the first battle, warriors under their king Nuada took Ireland from the Fir Bolg. In the second and better-known battle, the tribe of Danu drove out the Fomorians. There Lugh killed his grandfather Balor and drove the Fomorians into the sea. The true site is disputed, but the plain lay in Connacht. Both County Mayo and County Sligo have been proposed. Near Sligo, megalithic remains may have given the plain its name, which means plain of the pillars.
